name: Simple Parchment
summary: A parchment arrives while you are away, and the sender may be Frang, your class trainer. He is waiting outside the Den in the Valley of Trials.

sections.title: A Message from Frang
sections.body: The parchment asks you to read it and speak with Frang, who waits outside the Den in the Valley of Trials.

faq.answer: It appears to have come from Frang, your class trainer.
Frang is outside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
The parchment says Frang has words for you when you are ready.

faq.q: What should I do with the parchment?
faq.answer: Read the parchment, then speak with Frang in the Valley of Trials.
